paul_signal_intelligence.title: Paul Signal Intelligence
paul_signal_intelligence.goal: Understand Paul's text, conversational context, images and audio as accurately as evidence allows while every uncertain case remains no-trade.
paul_signal_intelligence.truth_statement: No architecture can guarantee 100 percent semantic understanding. The target is maximum measured coverage with deterministic fail-closed execution gates.
paul_signal_intelligence.current_recommendation: Advance all five Paul channels in parallel on the current stack, add the small-budget local multimodal shadow layer, and make a medium-budget decision only after a labeled per-channel evaluation set proves the remaining gap.

capabilities.action_policy: Eligible only on separately approved execute channels after all safety gates
Classify as non-actionable unless an exact command contract is present
Image alone never authorizes a trade
Transcript plus exact same-channel context required; uncertainty abstains
Two matching reviewers required; no label changes runtime rules automatically
Drift raises a review flag only; it never changes rules or channel modes
No automatic parser change or execute promotion
Each channel and instrument requires its own future exact fixture, symbol, tick, tests, flat ownership gate and exact approval

roadmap.work: Harden text and isolated same-channel context across all five channels
roadmap.exit_evidence: Per-channel fixtures, focused tests and zero cross-channel leakage

roadmap.work: Build sanitized image and audio shadow intake
roadmap.exit_evidence: No-history delivered-event pipeline, retention policy and no-trade media tests

roadmap.work: Create labeled Paul evaluation corpus with balanced coverage per channel
roadmap.exit_evidence: Partner-reviewed labels for action, joke, result, promotion, ambiguity and lifecycle intent
Measured precision, recall, calibration, abstention and adversarial tests

roadmap.work: Promote channels and instruments individually in guarded demo
roadmap.exit_evidence: Independent terminal readiness gates and exact Supervisor approval for each scope

roadmap.work: Scale infrastructure only if economics support it
roadmap.exit_evidence: Measured operational bottleneck and partner budget decision

investment_options.analysis_host: Existing Mac plus local Codex development tools
investment_options.language_stack: Deterministic parser, same-channel context, offline shadow learning
investment_options.media_stack: Metadata only; image and audio content remain DATA_MISSING
investment_options.monitoring: Existing supervisor JSON and Streamlit dashboard
investment_options.best_for: Finishing text semantics, collecting exact fixtures and proving value before buying infrastructure
investment_options.main_limit: No production OCR, speech transcription, multimodal model or independent service redundancy

investment_options.analysis_host: One Linux mini-PC or small VPS isolated from MT5
investment_options.language_stack: Current deterministic parser plus local small language model or capped API reviewer
investment_options.media_stack: PaddleOCR or Tesseract for images, whisper.cpp or capped transcription API for audio, all shadow-only
investment_options.monitoring: Current Streamlit dashboard plus uptime alerts and optional Tailscale access
investment_options.best_for: Learning Paul's wording and testing image and audio understanding without a large commitment
investment_options.main_gain: Adds measurable OCR, speech and semantic shadow coverage
investment_options.main_limit: Limited redundancy and more manual review of low-confidence cases
investment_options.recommendation: Best immediate value after text-context staging

investment_options.execution_host: Dedicated Windows VPS for one active MT5 execution instance
investment_options.analysis_host: Separate Linux application and AI service
investment_options.language_stack: Deterministic rules plus structured multimodal model review and versioned evaluation suites
investment_options.media_stack: OCR, chart-region extraction, speech transcription and vision-language review with confidence calibration
investment_options.monitoring: Prometheus or equivalent metrics, Grafana or current dashboard, alerting and error tracking
investment_options.best_for: Reliable 24/7 demo operation, partner reporting and continuous supervised learning
investment_options.main_gain: Strong auditability, measurable multimodal quality and reduced machine dependency
investment_options.main_limit: Requires DevOps ownership, labeling discipline and recurring cloud or API cost
investment_options.recommendation: Decide after the small pilot has a labeled accuracy report

investment_options.execution_host: One active Windows MT5 host plus guarded warm standby; never dual-active trading
investment_options.analysis_host: Redundant application services and dedicated or managed GPU inference with cloud fallback
investment_options.language_stack: Model ensemble, retrieval over approved Paul corpus, automated evals, drift detection and human review console
investment_options.media_stack: Redundant OCR, ASR and vision pipelines with disagreement detection and calibrated abstention
investment_options.monitoring: Full metrics, logs, traces, security audit, on-call alerts, service objectives and incident runbooks
investment_options.best_for: Commercial-scale operation with formal uptime, audit and governance expectations
investment_options.main_gain: Highest availability, strongest governance and fastest measured learning loop
investment_options.main_limit: High cost and complexity; semantic ambiguity still cannot be eliminated
investment_options.recommendation: Do not fund before medium-tier evidence proves return on complexity
